jobs.description: At Curtins, we re an employee-owned engineering consultancy driven by a simple ambition: to create a better built environment for everyone. For over 65 years, we ve delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. From major regeneration schemes and commercial developments to education, healthcare and residential projects, our work helps shape the places where people live, learn, work and thrive. As a Graduate Transport Planner, you ll work alongside experienced planners, engineers and consultants, contributing to a wide range of projects while developing the technical and professional skills you need to build your career. Whether you re interested in transport assessments, active travel & sustainable mobility, highways or public transport, we ll give you the experience, guidance and support to find the areas that interest you most and develop your expertise in development planning. What you ll be doing You will support the planning and development process, helping clients bring projects forward from initial concept through to planning approval. Your responsibilities will include: Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements. Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports. Analysing traffic, transport and movement data. Assisting with junction assessments and development impact studies. Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments. Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions. Attending client meetings, project discussions and stakeholder consultations. Taking part in wider Curtins activities including STEM outreach, charity initiatives and community projects. What kind of projects will I get to work on? You ll be involved in projects across a wide range of sectors, including: Residential developments. Urban regeneration schemes.
